info.description: A connected mailbox (personal or shared), read LIVE over IMAP — no sync, no mirror. Messages are only persisted when linked (import-on-demand, see docs/todo/email-program/). Credentials are AES-256-GCM ciphertext, never plaintext.

email.description: The mailbox address; also the default From.

imap_secure.description: true = implicit TLS; false = STARTTLS upgrade.

imap_password_enc.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext (v1:iv:tag:ct) keyed by MAIL_CRED_KEY. Written only by the controller; read only via the service's raw query.

smtp_password_enc.description: Same crypto as imap_password_enc. Blank = reuse the IMAP password.

provisioning_source.description: mailcow rows are managed by the M5 provisioning flow.

special_folders.description: Detected SPECIAL-USE map {sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive} — cached at validate/first connect.

unseen_counts.description: Written by the M1 unseen-count poller: {"INBOX": 4, ..., "checked_at": ISO}.

access_roles.description: Shared accounts only: app-role KEYS (e.g. ["crm_staff"]) whose holders may use this inbox without being listed in owners. Checked by ensureAccountAccess alongside owners.
